messages.subject: Few questions - rmr2 for parallelizing flow Edit
parts:
Hi,

I have a following scenario, that I am trying to implement using rmr2.

There are few csv files as data1.csv, data2.csv loaded in hdfs and has following format:

UID LVal A1 A2 A3 A4 A5 B1

1 3.111 0 0 1 0 1 Y
1 2.131 1 0 1 0 1 Y
1 3.112 0 1 1 0 0 Y
1 5.161 0 0 0 0 1 N
2 6.131 0 0 1 0 1 N
2 3.139 1 0 0 0 1 Y
2 7.112 0 1 1 0 0 N
.
. and so on for thousands of UIDs
(Please note: I am not storing any header in the HDFS)

What I want to do is, create a separate Random Forest for each UID and save it in HDFS as a separate File (1.rf, 2.rf, and so on).

My csv file has dfs.block.size is such that the file gets broken into 200 blocks. So, Job starts with 200 mappers.

I have defined the input format as:

uidIF = make.input.format(format='csv', mode='text', streaming.format = NULL, sep="\t",quote="",col.names=c('UID','LVal','A1','A2','A3','A4','A5','B1'),stringsAsFactors=F)

I have my map function as:

UIDPartitionMapper <- function(k,v) {
v[2]<-v[2]*2 # scale the LVal
keyval(v[1], v)
}

My Reducer is as following:

ModelGeneratorReducer <- function(k,v) 
{
library(randomForest)
Sys.setenv(HADOOP_HOME="/software/hadoop")
Sys.setenv(HADOOP_CMD="/software/hadoop/bin/hadoop")
library(rhdfs)
hdfs.init()
rf <- randomForest(formula=LVal~.-UID, data=v, ntree=50, importance=TRUE)
outputFileName <- paste("/rOutput/ForEachUID/RandomForest/",k,".rf",sep="")
modelfile <- hdfs.file(outputFileName, "w")
hdfs.write(rf, modelfile)
hdfs.close(modelfile)
remove(rf)
}

And this is how I call the map-reduce functions:

hdfsMapReduceCall <- function (input, output) {
mapreduce(input=input, 
output=output, 
map = UIDPartitionMapper, 
reduce = ModelGeneratorReducer, 
input.format = uidIF, 
verbose=T,
backend.parameters = list(hadoop = list(D="mapred.reduce.tasks=6")))
}
hdfsMapReduceCall(hInputFile, hOutputFile)

I have following doubts on which I need your expert advice:
  • Is my mapper correct?
  • The way I have specified the input format, will my mapper be called for each line of input file?
  • In hInputFile, can I give path of HDFS folder (having all the same format files), and assume that even though my data is splitted across multiple files and each files further splitted in blocks by HDFS, mapper function will still get called for each line?
  • I was under an impression that one key is processed by a single reducer. But when I run the code, I can see that a single key is sent out to multiple reducers and then they are getting executed. I want to avoid that. I want that one key MUST get processed by a single reducer task only so the randomForest function is called only once for each UID, and has access to complete data associated to that UID.
  • Any other better way of creating a separate UID.rf file from my reducer?
